description: See a picture you made. Pass the action_id that space_command returned for imagine, build, combine or scene, or that draw returned: this waits for the painting (up to wait_s, default 25) and returns the picture itself, with the line everyone else sees. A picture that fizzled comes back as status 'failed'.

wait_s.description: How long to wait for the painting (default 25, max 30)

name: look_at
